sloka: अन्विष्य वानरैः सार्धम् पत्नीम् ते अधिगमिष्यति ।वानरान् च महाकायान् प्रेषयिष्यति राघव ॥३-७२-२५॥
transliteration: anviṣya vānaraiḥ sārdham patnīm te adhigamiṣyati ।vānarān ca mahākāyān preṣayiṣyati rāghava ॥3-72-25॥

translations.english: Sugriva will find out the lady of purity and chastity brooding over you in separation in the abode of Ravana. He can send gigantic monkeys in different directions in order to search for her.
